full_judgment: 11. From the sprit of the impugned order dated 5-10-2008 passed by the tribunal below it appears to us that he was labouring under an impression that it would be beyond legal norm to release the victim to the custody of her mother when she was released on ad interim bail on an application by her under section 498 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 13454 of 2008. His impression was that such bail was granted to the victim by the High Court Division by seeing her appearance in person and that, therefore, she must be a major and cannot thus be subjected to the custody of her mother. In addition, he took the view that her date of birth in the National Identity Card (which is also a voter Registration Card) being recorded as 5-2-1988, she must be a major and cannot be given to the custody of her mother. In this regard learned Deputy Attorney- General has submitted that National Identity Card is most recent in origin and was prepared after the alleged date of commission of offence when the victim was under the influence or in the custody of the accused. In the face of passport of the victim issued on 21-1-2003, certificate of the Head Master of her school, tuition fees realisation card and money receipts issued by her school and also the national identity card issued by the Kuwait Government all taken together it would show that she is a minor below 15. Presumption can also be drawn that a student of Class VIII cannot be exceeding 14/15 years of age.
